query: 2025年每月的订单总金额，以及相比上月的增长率

outcome.sql: WITH "monthly_orders" AS (SELECT TO_CHAR("o"."order_date", 'YYYY-MM') AS "month", SUM("o"."amount") AS "total_amount" FROM "public"."orders" "o" WHERE "o"."order_date" >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND "o"."order_date" < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY TO_CHAR("o"."order_date", 'YYYY-MM')), "monthly_with_prev" AS (SELECT "mo"."month" AS "month", "mo"."total_amount" AS "total_amount", LAG("mo"."total_amount") OVER (ORDER BY "mo"."month") AS "prev_amount" FROM "monthly_orders" "mo") SELECT "mwp"."month" AS "month", "mwp"."total_amount" AS "total_amount", CASE WHEN "mwp"."prev_amount" IS NULL OR "mwp"."prev_amount" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((("mwp"."total_amount" - "mwp"."prev_amount") / "mwp"."prev_amount") * 100, 2)::text || '%' END AS "growth_rate" FROM "monthly_with_prev" "mwp" ORDER BY "mwp"."month" ASC LIMIT 40
